requirement_text.REQ-154: In-band instruction budget for Lua script execution (LUA-08 layer 1). Configurable :max_instructions budget, structured {:error, {:budget_exceeded, limit}} error, tests for all 4 acceptance criteria, moduledoc with LUA-08 layer-1 restatement and INV-2/INV-4 non-port explanation.

acceptance_criteria: the instruction budget is configurable (not a hardcoded literal) and a test drives two different configured budgets and asserts the smaller one halts a loop sooner
a test runs an unbounded `while true do end` loop under a configured budget and asserts the execution terminates rather than hanging

budget exhaustion surfaces as a structured error value distinguishable by pattern match from other failure arms, asserted by a test that matches on it specifically rather than on a catch-all {:error, _}
a test asserts what a script that pcalls its own budget exhaustion does, matching REQ-148's spike answer (a); assert {:ok, %{manifest_hash: _}} (pcall catches, loop stops, no continuation hazard)
the moduledoc states that this requirement RESTATES LUA-08 as layer 1, :max_instructions is in-band and pcall-catchable, REQ-155 supplies layer 2
the moduledoc states that R-Co's INV-2 and INV-4 do not port
mix test and mix compile --warnings-as-errors both pass with real output quoted

task.description: Write or validate the test spec for REQ-154 at test/specs/REQ-154.md. ELIXIR-DEV has already written 4 new tests in test/letflow/engine/lua/executor_test.exs for AC-1..4. Your job: (1) read the existing tests; (2) verify they cover all 7 acceptance criteria; (3) write test/specs/REQ-154.md documenting what each test validates and why. If any AC is not covered by an existing test, write the missing test code as a spec (not in the .exs file -- TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR and TEST-RUNNER will catch gaps). Do NOT run mix test yourself -- that is TEST-RUNNER's job.
acceptance_criteria: test/specs/REQ-154.md exists and covers all 7 ACs
AC-3: structured error pattern-match test documented
AC-4: pcall-catches-budget test documented (expected {:ok, _} per REQ-148 spike OQ-2(a))
AC-5 and AC-6: moduledoc content verification noted (to be verified by reading executor.ex)
AC-7: covered by TEST-RUNNER (mix test/compile step)
Each test entry in the spec names the test module, describe block, and test name

result.summary: test/specs/REQ-154.md written. All 7 ACs documented: AC-1..4 covered by 4 new ExUnit tests in describe 'instruction budget (REQ-154)'; AC-5 and AC-6 covered by @moduledoc source text assertions (both present and quoted); AC-7 deferred to TEST-RUNNER for real mix test/compile output.
